sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust across copper (Rio2, Sarytogan), gold (Auric, Forrestania, Aureka, Manhattan), and rare earths (Lindian). However, bond yield spike and AUD weakness create mixed signals for commodity exporters.
sectors.implications: Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid bond turmoil. Copper/rare earths names face near-term volatility but long-term structural demand intact. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX pressured by global risk-off; gold names (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) relatively resilient.

sectors.trend: RBA continuing to hike despite 5-year high unemployment creates credit stress risk. House price falls (largest in 40 years) threaten mortgage book quality. Bond yield spike compresses net interest margins.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield curve inversion and rising NPLs. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by higher borrowing costs and falling property values.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom straining grid capacity; energy 'hysteria' accelerating. Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian fuel supply chains. Nuclear energy debate intensifying.
sectors.implications: Energy names (WES.AX, SXG.AX, AGL.AX) face policy uncertainty but benefit from structural demand. Trump diesel ban (headline 54) could disrupt transport and agricultural fuel costs, pressuring margins across sectors.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalating; Ozempic boom reshaping fast-food demand. Gen Z 'going without' for housing signals structural consumer squeeze. Renters financially stressed.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (Qantas/Jetstar) faces cost pressure from industrial action. WES.AX, WOW.AX, CPL.AX under pressure from consumer affordability crisis. McDonald's (MCD) grappling with Ozempic demand shift.

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race intensifying (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, SK Hynix). Salesforce 'New Clippy' launch. AI workplace integration accelerating. Data centre energy demand a constraint.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but indirect via data centre energy demand and cloud infrastructure. Australian tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI adoption narrative but remain small-cap.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike / global bond market turmoil
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration bonds and quality equities with strong cash flows. Monitor 10Y AUS bond yields.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes amid rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers. Favour banks with strong capital buffers. Monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX credit metrics.
Resource exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) benefit from weaker AUD in USD terms. Importers and consumer staples face margin pressure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump diesel export ban / trade policy disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Assess exposure to fuel-dependent sectors (agriculture, transport, logistics). Diversify away from single-jurisdiction trade dependencies.
Reduce exposure to property developers and REITs. Monitor bank NPL ratios. Consumer discretionary names at risk.
Monitor QAN.AX earnings guidance. Industrial action could extend into peak travel season.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven flows and bond turmoil
opportunities.rationale: Rising yields and geopolitical risk (Trump policy, UN tensions) support gold. Multiple WA discoveries (Auric, Forrestania) signal sector activity.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective copper/rare earths exposure on structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Rio2 Peruvian drill, Sarytogan 452m copper intercept, Lindian rare earths nearing production signal long-term supply tightness.

opportunities.recommendation: Energy infrastructure plays on data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Data centre boom creating structural energy demand; nuclear debate may unlock new generation capacity. WES.AX, SXG.AX benefit from grid investment.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Largest house price falls in 40 years, rising rates, and renter stress create downside risk for property-linked equities.
Gen Z affordability crisis, Ozempic demand shift, and Jetstar industrial action pressure consumer spending.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with USD-denominated resource exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; resource exporters earn in USD, providing natural hedge.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from bond yield spike, RBA hawkishness, and global risk-off. Expect continued weakness in ^AXJO over 1-3 months. Unemployment data and RBA commentary will dominate. AUD likely to remain under pressure. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Intergenerational Report 2026 signals fiscal tightening. Housing correction may extend. However, resource sector structural demand (copper, gold, rare earths) and energy transition capex provide medium-term support. RBA likely to pivot once labour market deteriorates further.
